summary: Iter 6 (Azure Voice Live migration). Verified full removal of classic Foundry code and Speech token relay. server.py contains: voicelive_configured(), _entra_token() (scope https://ai.azure.com/.default), _voicelive_url() building wss://<VOICELIVE_ENDPOINT>/voice-live/realtime with api-version + agent-project-name + agent-id/name + agent-version, _session_update() injecting avatar {character:'lisa', style:'casual-sitting', output_protocol:'webrtc'}, and WebSocket route /api/voice/ws relaying via websockets.connect (headers api-key OR Bearer Entra token). No /api/avatar/chat, /api/avatar/credentials, /speech token endpoints, no threads/messages/runs, no assistant_id or agent_id create-run left. Backend pytest: 15/15 pass, including: GET /api/config -> {voicelive_configured:false, avatar_character:'lisa', avatar_style:'casual-sitting'}; legacy /api/avatar/* return 404; WS /api/voice/ws (wss on public host) returns JSON {type:'error', error.message contains 'not configured'} and closes without crash; orders+items search regression intact (total=1000, filters/pagination/q/date). Frontend LisaAvatar.jsx code-inspected: no microsoft-cognitiveservices-speech-sdk import; uses new WebSocket to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL with http->ws replaced, path /api/voice/ws; sends {type:'start', auto_turn}; on 'session.updated' builds RTCPeerConnection with session.avatar.ice_servers, adds mic track, addTransceiver('video',{direction:'recvonly'}), base64-encodes SDP and sends {type:'session.avatar.connect', client_sdp}; on 'session.avatar.connecting' base64-decodes server_sdp and setRemoteDescription; ontrack attaches video/audio elements. Frontend browser test (public URL): lisa-toggle-fab opens lisa-popup with lisa-video/lisa-transcript/lisa-text-input/lisa-send-btn/lisa-hints/lisa-autoturn-checkbox (checked by default)/lisa-power-switch/lisa-close-btn. Toggling power ON without Azure shows 'Azure Voice Live isn't configured yet...' in transcript, no crash. Config-driven commands verified: 'show delivered orders' -> 186 orders, 'high priority paid orders' -> 216, 'find order ORD-100200' -> 1, 'electronics in stock' -> auto-navigated to /items and 198 items, 'read the top order' -> reads ORD-100200 James Miller Delivered Low unpaid $1006 North America, 'go to Order Search'/'navigate to items search' navigate correctly, 'reset filters' -> 1,000, 'next page'/'previous page' work, hint chip lisa-hint-show-delivered-orders clickable and applies filter.

lisa-power-switch ON (unconfigured) shows 'Azure Voice Live isn't configured yet...' transcript, no crash
'electronics in stock' auto-navigates to /items and filters (198)
'read the top order' reads top row
'go to Order Search'/'navigate to items search' navigate
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: _date_filter builds date_to as a string like '<date>T23:59:59.999999+00:00' but the field values in the DB are ISO strings — comparison works since both are strings, but a mixed len(date_to)==10 vs full-ISO branch is fragile. Consider normalizing.

server.py voice_ws: browser->azure loop calls json.loads(raw) — malformed frames from client will crash the coroutine and be silently caught by outer try. Non-blocking but adding a try/except around json.loads inside the loop would be more robust.

LisaAvatar.jsx sets <video muted> and separates audio via <audio autoPlay>. Correct, but relies on browser allowing autoPlay for the audio element. In some browsers this may require a user gesture even after switch click — worth a follow-up if live testing reveals silence.
Backend .env keeps VOICELIVE_API_VERSION default '2026-04-10' — good; ensure it's parameterized in code (it is).
server voice_ws: no timeout/heartbeat on the upstream websockets.connect — a stuck upstream will keep the browser socket half-open until the browser closes it. Consider ping_interval/ping_timeout.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Azure creds intentionally empty here, so the live WebRTC/avatar path cannot be exercised. When the user fills VOICELIVE_ENDPOINT + FOUNDRY_PROJECT_NAME + FOUNDRY_AGENT_ID (or NAME) + optionally FOUNDRY_AGENT_VERSION + either VOICELIVE_API_KEY or (AZURE_TENANT_ID/CLIENT_ID/CLIENT_SECRET) in backend/.env, /api/config voicelive_configured flips true and /api/voice/ws opens an upstream socket. Backend tests file is /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (loads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via python-dotenv from frontend/.env). WS test uses websockets.sync.client on wss://<REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL host>/api/voice/ws.
